groups.defect: Returning null from getSubGroupsCount() after concurrent deletion breaks the expected non-null count contract, allowing null representation values and downstream unboxing NPEs.
groups.rationale: All three report the same null fallback at the same location and its consequences for consumers. Preserving a non-null return value resolves all three.

groups.defect: The test asserts caughtExceptions before joining the reader thread, so failures from an in-flight request can arrive after the assertion and be missed.
groups.rationale: Every member identifies the same missing synchronization between reader completion and the assertion. Joining the reader before asserting also addresses the mentioned thread surviving beyond the test.
